text:
harry: Quick check-in. ranker-compact-int8 bringup shows MRR +2% but NDCG@5 -4% on sample_harness. Pattern: head improves, tail suffers. anyone free to eyeball?

mina: do we have per-query diffs and top-k doc ids? that usually gives the clue.

harry: ran `./eval_small --model=ranker-compact-int8 --cohort=sample_harness --k=5 --seed=7 --emit-diffs` and attached a tiny excerpt. Many queries swapped a mid-rel doc for a very short snippet doc at rank1.

tariq: sounds like a length-related feature change. any recent proto/feature-encoding changes in the int8 path?

harry: we recently changed length -> float bucket serialization: used to be one-hot, now packed as a scaled float vector to save memory for int8.

mina: that can introduce rounding bias if scaling factor mismatches downstream dequant. Can you show sample feature values (fp16 vs int8 pipeline) for the short-doc hits?

harry: snippet:
```
# query X
len_fp16 = 12 -> len_feat = 0.71
len_int8 = 12 -> len_feat = 0.68
score_fp16 = -0.42 -> score_int8 = -0.20
```
harry: length feature compressed slightly lower on int8 -> model prefers short doc -> top1 shift.

june: also check any post-quant rescale/clamp. we added a safety clamp in quantizer: `clamp=0.99` after a bad kernel run. that reduces dynamic range.

tariq: combo of clamp + packed-length rounding fits the symptom. Action items: 1) revert length serialization to one-hot for int8 path (maintain parity), 2) make clamp adaptive (only for kernels that overflow), 3) add a head/tail metric split to CI dashboard.

harry: starting PR with revert + test. I'll also add a tiny synthetic where we assert top-k parity for short-doc queries between fp16 and int8 (seeded).

ci-bot: CI job 67211 started for branch/feat/length-fix (unit tests + eval smoke).

mina: also suggest we log top-3 doc ids for sampled live requests during canary so shifts are visible.

harry: will add 0.5% sample logging to canary. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rerank/pull/2679 assigned to @mina.

ci-bot: job 67211 finished (success). artifacts: s3://ci/67211/metrics.json

mina: reviewed and left a couple small comments on test timeouts; otherwise looks good.

harry: thanks all. followups in PR. note-to-self: when onboarding quant models, always include per-query id diffs + head/tail split in the initial checklist.

june: great triage. short doc bias is a recurring pattern, happy we have a reproducible test now. :thumbsup:
